payingUser: A parent of a learner driver who has to certify supervised day and night driving hours to a state licensing office.
paidUnit: A one-time remove-ads and export unlock that produces a printable, per-drive hour summary the parent can hand to a licensing office.
momentOfPayment: When the parent taps Export to prepare the licensing-office summary, and again after the fifth logged drive when the next banner asks to remove ads.
distinctnessSentence: It exports a printable day and night hour summary without crashing and keeps the hours on the phone instead of behind a state or DMV login, where the measured incumbent crashes on export and the shelf leaders are classroom test-prep apps.
day1RevenuePath: Free and ad-supported from the first logged drive; the first dollar is an export unlock bought by a parent who needs the summary for a licensing appointment.
assumptionsUnverified: That parents will pay to remove ads or unlock export at all, because the measured category norm is a free app with ads and the 4.2-star incumbent's own review calls the absence of ads a positive.
That the day and night hour rules of each state can be encoded as data without the app becoming legal advice, and that those rules are stable enough to hardcode.
That a seasonal 30-day-use utility can hold enough daily users for ads to pay anything, which the factory's own ad arithmetic says needs 2,000 to 6,000 DAU.
